author: raoatifshad
body:
#### PR description:
Fix the handling of unavailable CUDA devices in TestDataFormatsPortableHeterogenousCudaAsync.

Currently, the test uses Catch2's FAIL() macro when no devices are available for the alpaka_cuda_async backend, although the failure message indicates that the test should be skipped.

Replace FAIL() with SKIP() so that the test is correctly reported as skipped when no CUDA device is available.
logs [here](https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/logreader/el9_amd64_gcc14/CMSSW_20_1_CUDART_X_2026-11-04-2300/gpu/nvidia_t4/unitTestLogs/DataFormats/Portable#/)
title: [GPU]DataFormats/Portable: Fix CUDA async test skip handling
